```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Load packages
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)

#Load in data
Solar_ATB <- read.csv("Processed_Data/Solar_ATB_Processed.csv")

#view(Solar_ATB)
Solar_ATB <- Solar_ATB %>%
  select(-"X") %>% 
  select(-"...1")

#view(Solar_ATB)

```



```{r}
gen1.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Class + Technology +
                Annual_Energy_Production,
             data = Solar_ATB)
```



```{r}
plot(gen1.lm)

```

```{r}

Solar_ATB_log <- Solar_ATB %>% 
  mutate(Annual_Energy_Production_log =
           log10(Annual_Energy_Production))

gen2.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Class + Technology +
                Annual_Energy_Production_log,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)


```


```{r}

plot(gen2.lm)

```

# Testing Net Capacity

```{r}
net1.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Net_Cap_Factor + Technology +
                Class,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)

Solar_ATB_log <- Solar_ATB %>% 
  mutate(Net_Cap_Factor_log =
           log10(Net_Cap_Factor))

net1.lm <- lm(LCOE ~
                Net_Cap_Factor_log + Technology +
                Class,
             data = Solar_ATB_log)

plot(net1.lm)

```
